ideas.pitch: Multilingual voice-first agricultural market intelligence and fair-pricing advisory copilot designed for UP farmers to counter middleman exploitation.
ideas.title: KrishiMandi AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets a core state government priority of improving farmer incomes, with a high likelihood of deployment by the Department of Agriculture.

ideas.pitch: Multilingual AI health companion for rural Uttar Pradesh providing preventive care advice, localized symptom checking, and vaccine tracking via simple WhatsApp and voice interfaces.
ideas.title: ArogyaSevak UP
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the success of SAGACITY by addressing rural health awareness in regional languages, resonating strongly with government and public-sector judges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered public grievance redressal assistant that automatically classifies citizen complaints, routes them to the correct UP state department, and tracks resolution progress.
ideas.title: Nagrik Sahayak Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an administrative pain point familiar to government officials in the room, focusing on operational efficiency and transparent e-governance.

ideas.pitch: Personalized AI tutor and learning gap analyzer for state-run primary schools in Uttar Pradesh, operating offline-first with regional language support.
ideas.title: Shiksha Sahayak AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to the Department of IT & Electronics mandate for scalable public sector impact and education uplifting in UP.

ideas.pitch: Computer vision and NLP pipeline to digitize, translate, and verify historical land registry documents and property dispute records in Uttar Pradesh.
ideas.title: BhoomiAI Land Records
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles a massive administrative bottleneck for the UP Revenue Department, offering immediate, quantifiable economic value and fraud reduction.
